purpose: One fixed-node diagnostic of the unchanged smooth-6-12 hybrid versus shipped HCE after weak equal-time play; separate from all previous one-shot experiments.
schedule: Opening order 0..99; white then black on even openings, black then white on odd openings.
scoreAnalysisRequires: Complete 200-game inventory; captured archive hashes and independent legal replay, repetition history, termination, and fixed-node metadata audit.
statistics: Descriptive candidate score and one-sided 95% t lower bound over 100 paired-opening means, separately per arm. No repeated seed slots. The exposed opening bank and modest node budget preclude formal generalization or shipping claims.
termination: Engine gameStatus rules including full-prefix repetition history, otherwise draw at 180 searched plies; no evaluator-score adjudication.
budgetJustification: 16,384 nodes was the existing higher frozen hybrid-runtime-v1 fixed-node throughput cell. Chosen before any game of this experiment; sufficient for a modest CPU diagnostic and avoids tuning a budget to outcomes. Early mate/max-depth termination may use fewer nodes.

decisionRule.promisingNext: Profile residual runtime costs and separately preregister a development equal-time screen closer to shipped levels. No immediate formal test or evaluator change.
decisionRule.otherwiseNext: Inspect move-ranking errors, tactical misses and phase transitions before further optimization or training.
decisionRule.interpretation: This threshold routes research only; paired score is descriptive and equal nodes allow different search trees. No significance, Elo, or shipping claim.

timingInterpretation: Other independent CPU development may run on this host. Wall-clock measurements in this node-capped match are descriptive only and cannot establish NPS or runtime improvement; separate isolated paired profiling is required.
